ageDays.description: Age of the video at collection time, in days.
ageDays.title: Age (Days)

appearances.description: Number of collected hashtag rows in which TikTok credited this creator.
appearances.title: Trend Appearances

author.description: Video author object: id, username, displayName, bio, followerCount and avatarUrl.
author.title: Author

bestRank.description: Creator's best top-creator rank across the collected hashtags.
bestRank.title: Best Rank

commentKeywords.description: Keywords TikTok extracted from the video's comments and their mention counts.
commentKeywords.title: Comment Keywords

contentTag.description: Content-tag ranking that surfaced this video (11002 Beauty & Care, 11003 Fashion, 11010 Food & Beverage, 11013 Lifestyle & Leisure, 11015 Technology & Finance). Omitted for the unfiltered ranking.
contentTag.title: Content Tag

countryCode.description: Creator country code as reported by TikTok.
countryCode.title: Country

coverUrl.description: Signed TikTok CDN cover link (temporary, about 48 hours).
coverUrl.title: Cover URL

createTime.description: Video publish time as a Unix timestamp.
createTime.title: Create Time (Unix)

createdAt.description: Video publish time in ISO 8601 UTC.
createdAt.title: Created At

creatorId.description: TikTok user ID for creator-leader rows.
creatorId.title: Creator ID

curveVolatility.description: Population standard deviation of the popularity curve values.
curveVolatility.title: Curve Volatility

embedUrl.description: Durable cookieless TikTok embed player URL (video rows).
embedUrl.title: Embed URL

engagementRate.description: TikTok's engagement rate for the video in the observed window.
engagementRate.title: Engagement Rate

engagementRateLifeTime.description: Lifetime engagement rate reported by TikTok.
engagementRateLifeTime.title: Lifetime Engagement Rate

followerCount.description: Highest follower count observed for the creator in the collected rows.
followerCount.title: Followers

hashtagId.description: TikTok's internal hashtag ID (string to preserve 64-bit precision).
hashtagId.title: Hashtag ID

hashtags.description: Hashtag names the creator was credited on (creator rows) or hashtags parsed from a video caption (video rows).
hashtags.title: Hashtags

industryIds.description: TikTok industry category IDs assigned to this hashtag.
industryIds.title: Industry IDs

industryNames.description: Human-readable names for the assigned industry categories.
industryNames.title: Industries

isOverallRanking.description: True when the hashtag appeared on the market's overall chart rather than only an industry chart.
isOverallRanking.title: Overall Chart

lifetimeViewsShare.description: Window views divided by lifetime views.
lifetimeViewsShare.title: Window Share of Lifetime Views

momentumChangePct.description: Change between the mean of the most recent third of the popularity curve and the third before it, as a percentage of TikTok's normalized index.
momentumChangePct.title: Momentum Change (%)

observedCountries.description: Markets in which the creator appeared (creator rows).
observedCountries.title: Markets

observedCountry.description: ISO country code of the market whose chart produced this row.
observedCountry.title: Observed Country

observedPeriod.description: Lookback window in days used for this row: 7, 30 or 90 for hashtags; 7 or 30 for videos.
observedPeriod.title: Observed Period (Days)

observedPeriods.description: Time windows in days in which the creator appeared (creator rows).
observedPeriods.title: Windows

organicViews.description: Organic (non-promoted) views within the observed window.
organicViews.title: Organic Views

organicViewsLifeTime.description: Lifetime organic video views reported by TikTok.
organicViewsLifeTime.title: Lifetime Organic Views

peakDate.description: Date of the highest popularity value in the window.
peakDate.title: Peak Date

peakValue.description: Highest popularity value in the window (TikTok's 0-100 index).
peakValue.title: Peak Value

popularityCurve.description: Day-by-day TikTok popularity index (0-100) for the observed window: [{date, value}].
popularityCurve.title: Popularity Curve

publishCnt.description: Number of posts published with this hashtag during the observed window.
publishCnt.title: Post Count

rankIndex.description: 1-based position in the overall chart when available, otherwise the best industry-chart position. See isOverallRanking and rankingSlices.
rankIndex.title: Rank

rankingKey.description: Provenance of the ranking that produced this row: market:window:sort:weeksBack:tag (tag 'all' = unfiltered).
rankingKey.title: Ranking Key

rankingSlices.description: Industry chart IDs in which the hashtag also ranked (present when it ranked in at least one industry slice).
rankingSlices.title: Industry Charts

rowType.description: Discriminator: 'hashtag' for ranked hashtag rows, 'creator' for the optional creator leaderboard, 'video' for trending-video rows.
rowType.title: Row Type

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when this row was collected.
scrapedAt.title: Scraped At

sixSecondViewRate.description: Share of viewers who watched at least six seconds.
sixSecondViewRate.title: 6-Second View Rate

sixSecondViewRateLifeTime.description: Lifetime share of viewers who watched at least six seconds.
sixSecondViewRateLifeTime.title: Lifetime 6-Second View Rate

topComments.description: Up to 50 most-liked comments on the video (when Include top comments is on).
topComments.title: Top Comments

topCreators.description: Creators TikTok credits for this hashtag: rank, ttuid, handleName, nickname, followerCount, countryCode and avatarUrl (signed CDN link).
topCreators.title: Top Creators

trendDirection.description: rising, steady or falling, derived from momentumChangePct with a +/-10% threshold.
trendDirection.title: Trend Direction

trendStage.description: breaking, peaking, fading or steady, derived from the curve peak position and recent change.
trendStage.title: Trend Stage

videoSortBy.description: Metric used for the video chart: views, engagementRate or sixSecondViewRate.
videoSortBy.title: Video Ranking Metric

videoUrl.description: Durable TikTok video page URL (video rows).
videoUrl.title: Video URL

views.description: Video views within the observed window.
views.title: Views

viewsLifeTime.description: Lifetime video views reported by TikTok.
viewsLifeTime.title: Lifetime Views

viewsPerDay.description: Window views divided by the video's age in days.
viewsPerDay.title: Views per Day

vv.description: Total video views accumulated by posts using this hashtag during the observed window.
vv.title: Video Views

weeksBack.description: How many weekly steps back the chart end date was moved for this row (0 = latest).
weeksBack.title: Weeks Back

overview.description: One row per hashtag, market and window, plus optional creator-leader and trending-video rows in the same dataset (see the rowType field).
overview.title: Hashtags Overview

videos.description: Video rows from the trending-video chart, with author context and engagement metrics.
videos.title: Trending Videos
